title: Tuxedo Brass Band under Eddie Jackson
summary: He left Excelsior for the Tuxedo Brass Band led by Eddie Jackson after Papa Celestin, played in Jackson's orchestra too, and praises Jackson as a tuba player; Jackson died c. 1935.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, I had him. And that's when I started out in the brass band. Well, we played in the brass band. I played with the Excelsior Band for maybe two, three years. Then I left the Excelsior Brass Band, I went with the Tuxedo Brass Band, which the leader of the band was Eddie Jackson. Yeah, I put a talk of him.
Oh yeah, some big tuba players.
Yeah, well, I played with Eddie Jackson brass, and I played with the Tuxedo Brass Band for quite a while. Well, the band is, when Eddie Jackson died, the band is, went to pieces. So that told me.
When did he die about? I never, of course, got to know him or hear him. I wondered, do you remember about what year did you, 10 and a half?
I don't know if he died in, I think 30 or 35, I think around 35, 1935, I think. It had been a while.
How long were you in the Tuxedo Band?
I was in the Tuxedo Band for about two years.
At that time did they have the Young Tuxedo Band already or not? Like John Kazimierz Band, it hadn't been started.

They had the Tuxedo Brass Band. It was first run under Papa Celestan. And after Papa Celestan gave it up, Eddie Jackson, the bass tuba player, kept the band going. So, well, he changed different men at the time. Of course, I think I was a good bass drum player, so he stole me from the Excelsior Brass Band. So that's why I started off with them. Then I used to play with Eddie Jackson Brass Orchestra, too, you see. Eddie Jackson had an orchestra. And a dance band.
You told me he played string bass for a while, too. Well, I don't remember him playing string bass,
but I know he was one of the greatest tuba players we've ever had in the city of New Orleans.
He played tuba in the dance band then?
Dance band and walking. When you played a bass, you're a man walking. When you played a bass, you're a man walking.
